name: Verification Code / OTP
subject: Your verification code
previewText: Use this code to verify your identity
description: Dark-themed OTP delivery with prominent code display for high visibility.
useCase: Send this template when users need to verify their identity using a one-time password. Common for two-factor authentication, new device verification, or sensitive operations.
customizationGuide: The verification code displays in a prominent cyan box. Change the code display colors by updating the background and border colors in the code display section. Adjust the font size if your codes are longer than 6 digits.
securityNotes: This template includes messaging that warns users not to share their code. Codes should expire after a short period (5-15 minutes). Always use secure channels for code delivery.
